newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Fletcher Energy's Rahi-1 well abandoned.
newsitem.headline: Fletcher Energy's Rahi-1 well abandoned.

text.p: Fletcher Energy said on Thursday that no commercial hydrocarbons had been found in its Rahi-1 well and it would be plugged and abandoned.
The Rahi-1 drilling site was located within Petroleum Mining Licence 381012, eight kilometres south east of the Maui B Platform.

Rahi-1 was an exploration well, drilled test for oil potential within the Kapuni Formation, in a structure separate from the main Maui accumulations. The well successfully penetrated the primary and secondary reservoir objectives to a total depth of 3,472 metres below mean sea level, Fletcher said.
